reel.caption:
₹2 lakh trip abroad: do you know how much TCS is collected upfront?

On an overseas tour package, TCS is now a flat 2% from the first rupee (from 1 April 2026). Earlier it was 5% up to ₹10 lakh.
On an illustrative ₹2 lakh package that's ₹4,000 collected at booking.
It isn't a fee: it shows in your tax credit statement and you claim it in your ITR, adjusted against tax or refunded.

Did you know TCS comes back when you file?

Sources: a chartered-accountant firm's TCS guide (Apr 2026) and a personal-finance magazine's Budget 2026 explainer (Feb 2026); the ₹ figures are our own illustrative arithmetic.

For education only. Not investment advice.
